window.fill_policy: none; sole exception is the Amendment A2 bounded reserve-snapshot rule below

calendar_completeness: a month/year is COMPLETE for a series only if every hour of the period is inside the window, inside the series scope, and observed; otherwise INCOMPLETE with the observed subtotal shown separately; all periods appear

hyperliquid_funding.unit: hourly applied funding rate, fraction of notional per hour
hyperliquid_funding.unit_check: modal exact fundingRate string 0.0000125 equals the 0.00125%/h venue baseline; settlements hourly
hyperliquid_funding.sign: positive = longs pay shorts = a short receives (raw sign unchanged)
hyperliquid_funding.ingestion: fundingRate and premium parsed as exact decimal strings (decimal.Decimal)
hyperliquid_funding.settlement_to_bucket: bucket_ms = floor_hour(payment_time_ms) - 3600000 (compensated-interval start; director decision D3); payment timestamp retained
hyperliquid_funding.duplicates: identical (same settlement hour, same fundingRate+premium) deduplicated and counted; conflicting duplicates are a data defect: stop and escalate

coinbase_spot.semantics: candle [time, low, high, open, close, volume]; time = bucket start, epoch seconds UTC; no-trade buckets are missing, never filled
coinbase_spot.field_used: close only, as reference mark; not execution proof
coinbase_spot.duplicates: identical full-row duplicates deduplicated and counted; conflicting duplicates are a data defect: stop and escalate

aave_v3_arbitrum_usdc_reserve.segment_rule: native USDC and USDC.e are separate dated segments; no stitching, no cutover construction, no combined series
aave_v3_arbitrum_usdc_reserve.field_used: apyBase only (base supply rate); apyReward excluded and the exclusion disclosed; generic apy field not used
aave_v3_arbitrum_usdc_reserve.field_convention: apyBase = (liquidityRate / 1e27) * 100 = Aave on-chain annualized linear-accrual rate in percent (APR), per pinned adapter evidence spanning the window

a2_bounded_snapshot_rule.applies_from: first hour boundary strictly after the snapshot timestamp
a2_bounded_snapshot_rule.max_validity_basis: documented delivered cadence of one snapshot per calendar date (controller_yield.js: max(timestamp) per date from an hourly-written table)
a2_bounded_snapshot_rule.truncation: never at or after the next snapshot's first applicable hour boundary
a2_bounded_snapshot_rule.beyond_bound: gap; missing snapshot days remain gaps; no indefinite carry
a2_bounded_snapshot_rule.label: derived hourly reserve rates are modeled approximations, not observed hourly returns

formulas.funding_sum: S = sum of hourly funding over observed window buckets, per $1 constant quote notional, exact decimal arithmetic
formulas.arithmetic_annualized_rate: R = 8760 * S / observed_hours; a rate description, not compounded APY, not an investable equity curve
formulas.distribution_stats: mean, median, p5, p95, min, max on float64 conversions; mean via exact float summation (fsum)
formulas.quantile_method: linear interpolation (type 7; the numpy default): h=(n-1)p, x[floor(h)] + (h-floor(h))*(x[floor(h)+1]-x[floor(h)])
formulas.sign_shares: shares of hours with f>0, f=0 (exact decimal zero), f<0 over observed hours
formulas.negative_run: maximal consecutive observed grid buckets with f<0 strictly; zero, positive, or missing hours break a run; COMPLETED iff immediately preceded and followed, inside the window, by an observed bucket with f>=0; runs adjacent to the window boundary or a missing bucket are CENSORED, listed separately, excluded from completed-run aggregates
formulas.spot_returns: r_k(t) = P(t)/P(t-k) - 1 for k in {1,24}, defined only when all k+1 hourly closes in [t-k,t] are observed; p1/p99 (type 7) and single worst up/down with UTC timestamps
formulas.reserve_accrual: per segment: hourly modeled accrual a(b)=(apyBase/100)/8760 on A2-derived hours; sum and arithmetic annualization 8760*mean on disclosed derived coverage
formulas.units: 1 bp = 1e-4; no APR/APY conversion other than the sealed reserve conversion; unlike return conventions never summed

arithmetic.distribution_statistics: float64 conversions of the exact values
arithmetic.float_output_format: fixed decimal formats: funding rates %.12f, returns %.8f, bps %.2f

cost_worksheet.status: modeled inputs, not empirical findings or current executable quotes
cost_worksheet.sensitivity: exactly one: all modeled costs x2

capital_bridge: symbolic only: funding=(N/C)*sum(funding); reserve=(R/C)*sum(reserve accrual); cost=cost dollars/C; no N/C or R/C selected
figures: F1 combined ETH/BTC hourly funding time series

environment.execution: all result computation and reproduction run host-side by the mechanical coordinator (DESIGN section 13, Amendment A4)
